about: Differences between picosim and the real RP2040 that are understood. tests/test_hwfacts.py fails only on a difference that is not listed here. Each entry matches by class (faults, decoder, flags, memory, timing), a regex on the encoding's name (from picosim/discover/v6m.py), and optionally regexes on the detail and on 'code' (the first instruction's bytes in hex as stored: '00bc' is 0xBC00). 'reason' is shown in report.md; 'todo' is what is still to decide or do.

known.name: ^CPS \(should-be bits wrong\)$
known.reason: UNPREDICTABLE encoding: CPS with its should-be bits 3:0 not 0010. The RP2040 ignores bits 3:0: 0xB660-0xB66F act as CPSIE i and 0xB670-0xB67F as CPSID i (PRIMASK read back, all 32 forms). picosim stops with 'Undefined instruction ... not a Cortex-M0+ instruction'.
known.todo: Decided 2026-11-12 (plan §9, S19 proposal 7): keep stopping (GNU as never emits these), but say the encoding is UNPREDICTABLE and what the Pico does. Not built yet: remove this entry when it is.

known.name: ^POP \{list\}$
known.reason: UNPREDICTABLE encoding: POP {} (0xBC00, empty register list). The RP2040 loads PC from [SP] and leaves SP unchanged (it branched to the word at SP). picosim does nothing and falls through.
known.todo: Decided 2026-11-12 (plan §9, S19 proposal 8): stop with an 'UNPREDICTABLE: empty register list' message. Not built yet: remove this entry when it is.

known.name: ^LDM Rn\{!\},\{list\}$
known.reason: UNPREDICTABLE encoding: LDM Rn!,{} (0xC800-0xCF00, empty register list). The RP2040 loads PC from [Rn] (7 of 8 then HardFault on the ROM word they load; 0xCA00 runs boot-ROM code and lands in the sled), Rn unchanged. picosim does nothing and falls through.
known.todo: Decided 2026-11-12 (plan §9, S19 proposal 8): stop with an 'UNPREDICTABLE: empty register list' message. Not built yet: remove this entry when it is.

known.name: ^STM Rn!,\{list\}$
known.reason: UNPREDICTABLE encoding: STM Rn!,{} (0xC000-0xC700, empty register list). The RP2040 adds 4 to Rn (it stores one word; B's cases aim it at ROM, so what it stores is not seen). picosim leaves Rn unchanged.
known.todo: Decided 2026-11-12 (plan §9, S19 proposal 8): stop with an 'UNPREDICTABLE: empty register list' message. Not built yet: remove this entry when it is.

known.name: ^(BX|BLX) Rm$
known.reason: BX/BLX to an address with bit 0 clear. The RP2040 completes the branch (PC = the target, LR set for BLX) and takes the HardFault (INVSTATE) at the target. picosim stops at the branch itself.
known.todo: Decided 2026-11-12 (plan §9, S19 proposal 2): match the chip: the branch completes and picosim stops at the target, with the message still naming the bad branch (line, register, value); Stage 4 makes it a real HardFault entry. Not built yet: remove this entry when it is.

known.name: ^(MSR spec_reg,Rn|MRS Rd,spec_reg|DMB .*|DSB .*|ISB .*)$
known.reason: UNPREDICTABLE encodings of MSR, MRS and the barriers: should-be bits not as the ARM ARM fixes them (e.g. MRS 0xF3E0..., barriers 0xF3B0-0xF3BE or hw2 not 0x8Fxx) or a reserved SYSm. The RP2040 runs them and falls through. picosim stops with 'Undefined instruction ... not a Cortex-M0+ instruction'.
known.todo: The same kind as proposal 7 (CPS). Awaiting the user's choice (asked 2026-11-12): (a) keep stopping, with an UNPREDICTABLE message that says what the Pico does, or (b) run them as the chip does (needs B5's data on what each form reads and writes). CPS follows the same choice.

known.name: ^MRS Rd,spec_reg$
known.reason: MRS Rd, MSP while Thread mode runs on PSP (CONTROL.SPSEL = 1, as the agent does): the RP2040 returns MSP. picosim has one SP and returns the SP in use.
known.todo: Decided 2026-11-12 (plan §9, S19 proposal 1): build MSP and PSP in Stage 4, with exception entry and return. Not built yet: remove this entry when it is.

known.name: ^MSR spec_reg,Rn$
known.reason: MSR MSP, Rn while Thread mode runs on PSP: the RP2040 changes MSP, not the SP in use. picosim has one SP and changes it.
known.todo: Decided 2026-11-12 (plan §9, S19 proposal 1): build MSP and PSP in Stage 4, with exception entry and return. Not built yet: remove this entry when it is.

known.name: ^PUSH \{list\}$
known.reason: UNPREDICTABLE encoding: PUSH {} (0xB400, empty register list). The RP2040 writes memory (B3: the scratch word at +0x800 and more); picosim writes nothing. B1's PUSH {} case matched; why B3's differ is part of the todo.
known.todo: New 2026-11-12: read B3's raw records to say exactly what the chip stores and whether SP changes; then, like proposal 8, stop with 'UNPREDICTABLE: empty register list'.
